en: Whoa, hey. Would that make you that angry?
What if I said no? Would you believe me?
Hmm. Probably not.
See? In the end, talk is cheap. That's why I prove myself through my actions.
Oh yeah? All righty, then. You're gonna come by the club every day from now on, right?
I, uh... Yeah. Sure.
How many guys have you dated?
Hmm. Lemme think. Like, five, maybe?
You don't sound too sure about that.
Wait, no. Three?
Why'd the number go down?
Well! Like, I don't know where things start to count as dating, is all.
Have you ever actually dated anyone?
Geez, Kiryu-san, why do y'have to be such a creep? Do ya always ask these kinda things?
Fine, you don't have to tell me.
Mind if I ask you something about yourself?
About me?
What's your best feature?
Hmm. I guess I've got a pretty good collarbone.
I just like how it's shaped. Did ya know that water pools up in mine?
Ah. They do say that's a mark of beauty.
Right? I smile when I see myself in the bathroom mirror.
Do you take actual baths?
Oh, I'm absolutely a bath person! You gotta get in a good soak to get properly refreshed.
Isn't taking baths time-consuming, though?
Well, that's why I read and stuff when I'm in the tub.
Sometimes on my days off, I'll blow through an entire novel while takin' a soak!
That's incredible.
Are you a shower person?
Do you only take showers, Kiryu-san?
I get home from work late a lot of the time. When I do, I just take a quick shower and then go right to bed.
I see. I'll cut into my sleep time just to make sure I get a bath in.
You really like baths, huh?
Let me be the judge of that.

en: Ack, hey! What are ya doin'!?
Weren't you trying to get me to check out your collarbone just now?
No! Stop ogling me like that! You're tryin' to sneak a look at my cleavage, aren't ya!?
I am not!
What do you consider your shortcomings?
Shortcomings, huh? I guess I can be pretty inattentive sometimes.
Inattentive in what way?
Like, if a customer's talkin', I'll kinda randomly smile and nod and make 'em mad.
I'm the same way. I'll have passengers chew me out for not listening to what they're talking about.
You too!?
Yeah. It's worse when they're drunk. No matter what I say, they want to turn it into some kind of argument.
I hear ya! That happens to me, too. Even when I'm actually listenin' carefully.
We're in the same boat, you and me.
You should listen more.
But I couldn't care less about some guy prattlin' on about how good he's doin' at work.
Is that so bad? A man who's good at his job is better than one that's not.
That's not the point! Girls couldn't care less about guys braggin' about themselves! It's so, so annoying!
If that was all, I'd let 'em get away with it, but then it's, oh, I'm friends with so-and-so and they're so amazin', blah, blah, blah. Just stop braggin', dude!
Do guys think that kinda talk appeals to women? I mean, for reals?
Okay, I hear you. Calm down.
Do you have any particular quirks?
Quirks, huh? Lemme think about that.
Aha, I got one!
When I'm deep in thought, I look up and to the side.
Heh, now that you mention it, I've picked up on that habit because it's so cute.
Hahaha! Oh, Kiryu-san, y'sure do know how to flatter a girl!
Anything else?
Anything else? Hmm.
Heh, you really do look up and to the side.
Say, I've been wondering about something.
What do you wear to bed?
What? Why do y'wanna know that?
I was just curious, that's all.
Hey, you're just bein' a perv!
No, I'm not. It's normal to wonder.
Well, I usually wear pajamas. They're kinda on the baggy side.
Baggy pajamas, huh?
You're still bein' pretty pervy...
What kind of kisser are you?
Kisser!?
I'm just curious how you kiss, is all.
Well, I guess I like simple ones. Pecks on the cheek and stuff. I'm not big on sloppy kissin'.
How's it like? Can we try?
How's it like⑬oh no, I'm not fallin' for that!
Well, it was worth a try.
What are your measurements?
I dunno. I'm not some pin-up girl y'know!
Well, how do you buy clothes without knowing your measurements?
Well, I know my chest and my waist sizes, but I dunno about my hips.
Haha! Don't be so disappointed! Tell ya what. I'll go ahead and take my measurements for you next time, okay?
So you know your chest size, then.
Geez, you're bein' a total perv, Kiryu-san. Ewww. No way am I tellin' ya that!
Just asking...
Welcome, Kiryu-san! I'm so happy ya picked me!
You came to see me? Does that mean ya like me?
Kiryu-san, I've been waitin' for ya! Today's gonna be a blast!
Nice to meet you. I'm Riku!
Here's my card. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Do you mind if I ask your name?
My name?
(Using my real name shouldn't be a problem.)
Kazuma Kiryu.
Well then, Kiryu-san, it's great to meet ya!
Nice to meet you too.
Hit me up anytime!
Just for you, Kiryu-san!
You smell really nice! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> Are you wearing cologne? I really like it!
Oh, look at you, all fancied up! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> You take real pride in your appearance, don't ya, Kiryu-san?
I like what you're wearing today. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I see you're wearin' the usual.
Did y'think those clothes look good on you?
...You're really not lookin' so hot.
Whoa, really!?
Oh wow, Kiryu-san, that's so generous of you!
Gold Champagne it is!
Gonna try your luck, huh?
All right, then! We'll keep your bottle for ya, Kiryu-san.
One bottle for storage!
All right. A house bottle it is, then.
Could you get me my bottle?
May I join you for a drink?
Oh, all right...
Your glass is empty. Did y'want some more?
May I have another drink?
(Damn, I don't have the cash.)
Sorry, no.
I'm kind of hungry.
What would y'like?
I'll have this please.
Oh, you like that, huh? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You like that? I never woulda figured.
Okay. Another time then.
Wanna play the chocolate stick game?
Heh, sure.
Here, I'll feed it to ya. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
C'mere, please!
I'm puttin' it together now.
You're quite the drinker!
Your glass is empty. Lemme fix that.
Thanks for comin'! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I have to be on my way.
Okay, can y'hang out somewhere and wait for me? I'll give you a call later, 'kay?
All right, let me get you your check, then.
You're leavin' already?
Sorry, I have to be on my way.
(Looks like we've run out of things to talk about. I should get going.)
Feel like coming out with me after this?
What? I already told ya no! Geez, you're a nag.
Askin' again ain't gonna change my mind!
Like after this?
Sorry, Kiryu-san. I've already got a previous engagement today. But ask me again next time.
Ah, all right. It's okay. I understand.
Hmm. Not today, sorry. I'm feelin' kinda off.
All right. Maybe another time, when you feel up to it.
Hmm. Maybe after we get t'know each other a bit better.
Okay, fine, if ya insist. But only for a little while, 'kay?
Haha. You wanna go out with me that bad? Sure. But just for a little bit, 'kay?
Sure. I've been wantin' to spend more time with ya myself.
Of course I do! There's no way I'd turn ya down, Kiryu-san.
That's what I like to hear.
Yeah, okay. I got nothin' else to do.
Oh wow, is this really for me?
But getting somethin' this expensive makes me feel kinda guilty.
Oh, no way! I had my eye on this! Thank you!
Are you sure!? I'll take good care of it!
Oh, thanks...
What's this? I dunno what to do with it.
Huh? You're givin' me another one?
But you already gave me this. Don't ya remember?
Kiryu-san, will y'come and see me again?
I'll ask for you next time.
You mean it? Then I'll be waitin'!
I had lotsa fun today!
Hehe. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Thanks for comin' by! See ya later!
I'll be waitin' for ya!
I'll see ya later! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Wonder what you're gonna get.
Oh, that one's kinda common.
Yeah, that's pretty okay I guess.
Oh, wow! Those are wicked rare!
Oh wow, you hit the jackpot! Congrats, Kiryu-san! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Time for the chocolate stick game!
One bottle of champagne!
Hello. Welcome to Prime.
You'd like to see Honoka-san? This way, sir.
I'm terribly sorry, sir, but Honoka-san isn't here at the moment, I'm afraid.
(Oops. I don't have enough money.)
(Maybe I should ask a question.)
(Maybe I should order something else.)
(She already turned me down once. I should wait until next time before I ask her again.)
Did ya come to Osaka for work, Akiyama-san?
Yeah. I was thinking about opening an office here, so I've been hitting up Sotenbori a lot.
Oh really now? I bet you're super rich!
I do all right. I make enough money to spend my time drinking with you like this.
Sounds like you're doin' well then! I hope you'll keep comin' to spend time here with me!
Don't I wish. I'm always running around trying to fix money problems.
Yikes. Ain't that unfortunate for ya.
Who knows? I've never stopped to think about just how much I have.
Say what now!? That's somethin' a rich person would say! I hope I'll get to say that sorta thing someday!
What do you usually do, Honoka?
Me? I'm goin' to school right now. I'm in my third year.
Of college? You're nothing like the typical girl who goes to college in Tokyo. You're much more of a go-getter, whereas they're more reserved.
We Osaka girls are renowned for our cheerful dispositions! All the girls in Tokyo got goin' for 'em is their looks!
You can say that again.
Of high school?

Could ya tell? Yeah, I'm actually still in high school...
 Pfft! As if! I'm no little kid!
Haha! I was kidding. But you've got a good sense of humor.
I won a prize in a beauty contest at my college, I'll have ya know.
Wow, that's amazing.
Ain't it just? I'm the number one girl in this club and outside of it!
You give off that impression. It's like an aura.
Yeah. Girls who can make number one all have something different about them than the rest.
I was just pullin' yer leg, actually.
Wait, seriously?
I mean I've won a prize, but not in any big name competition, and my rank here at the club is pretty average.
Why did you lie about that?
Goin' with the flow? I thought it'd be funny.
Do you study?
'Course. I'm takin' on more credits than I need so that come next year, I might not need to go to school as much.
You're more diligent than I'd have guessed.
You bet I am. If I didn't make sure to go to class, then payin' tuition would be a waste.
No, I get that. It's just... Look, I think you've got a lot to be proud of.
A prize? What place did you get?
Why're ya askin' for details I didn't give!? You're not supposed to go there!
It's just that usually someone would say they won the grand prize or whatever.
Fine. I got third place.
Go figure. I expected something like that.
Still! I wasn't lyin' about winnin' a prize.
I'm not saying that's bad. It takes courage to enter a beauty contest. And winning third prize is no small feat.
Layin' the praise on me at this point doesn't really mean much after havin' said all that.
Though speakin' of which, my rank at the club ain't really number one, either.
That's still impressive. You shouldn't worry about admitting that.
Yeah? But when I mentioned enterin' a beauty contest, the other girls got all snide, sayin' stuff like, "Oh, so ya think you're cute, huh?"
I bet they're all laughin' at me behind my back now.
Let them talk. The people who voted for you still thought you were the best, right?
I never thought 'bout it that way. Hehe! Ya sure know how to butter a girl up, Akiyama-san!
Hey, it wasn't mere flattery.
What's yer blood type, Akiyama-san?
My blood type? I'd... rather not say.
Huh? How come?
Because you seem like the kind of girl that'll go into some blood type compatibility spiel if I do.
Aha! Are ya afraid we're not compatible?
Basically. I keep my blood type a secret in order to avoid any weird preconceptions in my relationships.
Hmm. So that's the kinda guy ya are. I think I've got yer blood type all figured out then!
Don't be ridiculous. You can't tell someone's personality from their blood type.
Sure ya can! Like I could never date a guy who's type O!
You're not type O, are ya, Akiyama-san?
Guess you'll never know.
And what's your blood type?
I'm AB!
And what personality does that indicate?
They say we come across as real prodigies, and that we're prone to split personalities.
Split personalities? Okay, whatever.
Also, we're introverts, have trouble expressin' our feelings or handlin' criticism, and can be really cold. But I dunno nothin' about that.
